item.title: fix: prevent plugin metadata rescans from stalling Gateway (#125596)
item.summary: fix: prevent plugin metadata rescans from stalling Gateway (#125596) * fix(plugins): preserve gateway metadata ownership Generic runtime contexts no longer displace the Gateway lifecycle snapshot, preventing repeated synchronous plugin inventory validation on session hot paths. * fix(gateway): reuse lifecycle plugin generation for turns * test(agents): align static runtime lifecycle expectations * test(gateway): refresh minimal runtime fixtures * test(runtime): pass lifecycle metadata explicitly * fix(skills): reuse gateway metadata for commands * test(gateway): prepare reply runtime for agent RPCs * style(agents): format rebased runtime preparation * test(gateway): prepare runtime for direct agent RPCs * test(gateway): provide direct agent runtime fixture * test(gateway): prepare chat send reply runtime * test(qa): await descendant process exit
